summary: Market Risk Manager candidate with ~7 years across market, interest-rate, and liquidity risk analytics, fixed-income valuation and credit-spread sensitivities, and independent review and challenge within a model-governance framework analogous to a second line of defense mandate. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement) at Moody's Analytics. Deep fixed-income valuation and risk-sensitivity expertise; stress and scenario analysis; VaR/CVaR portfolio risk from Ortec. CFA charter and dual MSc.

roles.title: Asst. Director - Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Independent Review, Challenge & Market Risk Measurement
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative) - independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to release.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, ensuring consistency of risk sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.
Escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility; serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Member of the model governance committee - contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

sections.heading: Interest Rate, Liquidity & Stress Analytics
bullets: Oversee interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with Basel-style interest-rate risk standards.
Led design of a multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios - delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across risk horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding and refinancing-risk assessment.

sections.heading: Stakeholder Communication, Tooling & Mentorship
bullets: Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities - translating quantitative outputs into decision-ready narratives.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines; contributed to mentorship of junior colleagues on validation and review practices.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform (PFaroe DB and PFaroe PM).
Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners; advised on asset, liability, and risk configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with risk and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program functions on standards adoption; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, attribution, and near-optimal frontier robustness analysis.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.
Delivered ALM studies analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk; presented findings to investment committees at pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
